focus: Client rule for AttachReady.last_live_seq after queued post-snapshot chunks

graphEvents.label: Ready sequence is an inclusive post-flush barrier
Barrier prefilter can lose queued chunks
Snapshot watermark is required for gap detection

label: Treat AttachReady.last_live_seq as an inclusive barrier emitted only after queued post-snapshot chunks flush
Client dedupe must use its highest contiguous applied seq; pre-discarding queued seq <= last_live_seq can lose data
An explicit snapshot_last_seq or equivalent replay watermark is needed to detect a missing first queued sequence
Before AttachReady is accepted, the client must have applied every contiguous live sequence from snapshot_last_seq + 1 through last_live_seq
AttachSnapshotChunk carries chunk ordering but no live sequence; AttachReady carries only the later live barrier

direction: discard every live chunk with seq <= AttachReady.last_live_seq
reason: Queued chunks must be applied before the barrier is used for confirmation; unconditional prefiltering can discard not-yet-applied data
